code_examples.section: ltm rule command DOSL7 is mitigated
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

DOSL7::is_mitigated
       Returns TRUE if certain HTTP request was mitigated by DOSL7.

SYNOPSIS
       DOSL7::is_mitigated

DESCRIPTION
       Returns TRUE if certain HTTP request was mitigated by DOSL7.

       Syntax

       DOSL7::is_mitigated

RETURN VALUE
       Returns TRUE if request was mitigated

VALID DURING
       ALL_EVENTS

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.1.0
		   --First introduced the command.
